requirements.title: L7 static enforcement verifiers present and CI-bound
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when all 6 L7 verifier scripts (verify_apps_rg_how_trace.py, verify_l7_fortknox_evidence.py, verify_apps_rg_l7_route_family_coverage.py, verify_r1a_exact_cache_l7_runtime.py, verify_r5_fallback_l7_runtime.py, verify_uwg_block_path_l7_runtime.py) exist and .github/workflows/apps-rg-auditability.yml binds them in fail-closed jobs.

requirements.title: 100% L7_AUDITABILITY plane coverage across governed route families
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when every RTC-REQ-130..138 is SIGNED_OFF AND the coverage matrix reports >=4 route families as REAL_RUNTIME CERTIFIED with no borrow, no fixture-only forgery, and no structural-only masquerade.

requirements.title: UWG_COMMIT_PATH chain integrated DurableWriteGateway successful-commit proof
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when the uwg_commit_latest chain bundle exists with uwg_commit_receipt.json commit_status=COMMITTED, snapshot_before != snapshot_after, audit_append_receipt_ref non-empty, and source_surface=Exit.

requirements.title: R3_GROUNDED_READ chain real C0 retrieval integrated runtime proof
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when the r3_latest chain bundle has final_evidence_contract.json with non-empty evidence_refs (each carrying chunk_ref + payload_sha256), bound to a deterministic corpus_manifest, and integrated_runtime_origin=True.

requirements.title: R4_SINGLE_ACTION chain real L2 tool invocation integrated runtime proof
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when the r4_latest chain bundle has sealed_l2_artifact.json with structural_only=False, tool_invocations non-empty and deterministic=True, and tool_authorization_receipt.json authorization_status=GRANTED.

requirements.title: MANAGED_WORKFLOW_REAL_EXECUTION composed-substrate integrated runtime proof
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when the mw_real_latest chain bundle has managed_workflow_real_execution_receipt.json with managed_workflow_certified=True, gate_verdicts length=29, gate_pass_count=29, gate_fail_count=0, and composed_substrates binds R3 + R4 + UWG_COMMIT receipts.

requirements.title: 100% L7 REAL_RUNTIME coverage: 8 of 9 route families REAL_RUNTIME CERTIFIED
requirements.acceptance_rule: ACCEPTED only when RTC-REQ-135..137 AND RTC-REQ-140..143 are all SIGNED_OFF AND the coverage matrix reports 8/9 route families as REAL_RUNTIME CERTIFIED (the 1 exception is MANAGED_WORKFLOW_STRUCTURAL which is STRUCTURAL_ONLY by design).
